long_biography.plain_text:
Colombian financier Andrés Piedrahita studied communications at Boston University before entering the securities industry in New York. At Prudential Bache he worked as a financial consultant; at Shearson Lehman Hutton he specialised in advising institutions and individuals outside the United States. His early professional experience centred on explaining investment products and developing relationships across national markets.

Fashion investor Lawrence Stroll later introduced him to an opportunity to buy Michael Kors shares before the company's public flotation. Piedrahita made the investment through Littlestone Associates after the financial crisis, committing his own capital to the fashion company.
